name: Danlaw Technologies India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Danlaw Technologies India Ltd is in the  business  of  providing  engineering  and  software  development  consulting services, Industrial electronics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
DTIL is an ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949-certified developer of technologies for connected car and automotive electronics. 
 It is one of the largest suppliers of connected gadgets in the world.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 50.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 33.2%
Company's median sales growth is 26.2% of last 10 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
